"71.05")) (withs (row (* #usd"500.00" (floor-float (/ (clamp-zero income) #usd"500.00"))) midpoint (+ row #usd"250.00") reduction (/ (* (clamp-zero (- midpoint start)) (int-to-float rate)) 100000.0)) (min largest (clamp-zero (round-dollar (- largest reduction))))))

; Form 1 line 8: the standard deduction for the filing status. A head of
; household's deduction falls faster, but never below a single filer's.
(def wi-standard-deduction ((y WisconsinYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (income Money)) Money :cite ((law "Wis. Stat." "71.05")) (withs (single (wi-sliding-deduction income (. y 'standard_deduction_single) (. y 'deduction_phase_start_single) (. y 'deduction_phase_rate_single))) (cond ((state-joint? status) (wi-sliding-deduction income (. y 'standard_deduction_joint) (. y 'deduction_phase_start_joint) (. y 'deduction_phase_rate_joint))) ((is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (wi-sliding-deduction income (. y 'standard_deduction_separate) (. y 'deduction_phase_start_separate) (. y 'deduction_phase_rate_separate))) ((or (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_HEAD_OF_HOUSEHOLD) (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_QUALIFYING_SURVIVING_SPOUSE)) (max single (wi-sliding-deduction income (. y 'standard_deduction_hoh) (. y 'deduction_phase_start_hoh) (. y 'deduction_phase_rate_hoh)))) (else single))))

; Form 1 line 12: below $100,000 the Tax Table, which figures the tax on the
; middle of each $100 row; from $100,000 the Tax Computation Worksheet, which
; is the rate schedule on taxable income itself. Either is rounded to the
; whole dollar.
(def wi-tax ((y WisconsinYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "Wis. Stat." "71.06")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) rows (wi-brackets status)) (if (< ti (. y 'tax_table_limit)) (withs (midpoint (+ (* #usd"100.00" (floor-float (/ ti #usd"100.00"))) #usd"50.00")) (round-dollar (state-bracket-tax rows midpoint false))) (round-dollar (state-bracket-tax rows ti false)))))

"71.05")) (+ (if (. hh 'taxpayer.can_be_claimed_as_dependent) 0 1) (if (and (state-joint? status) (not (. hh 'spouse.can_be_claimed_as_dependent))) 1 0) (state-dependent-count hh tax-year)))

; separately, Schedule I for everyone else.

; Form IT-140, West Virginia Personal Income Tax Return, for full-year
; residents.
;
; The return starts from the prepared federal return: federal AGI, the
; federal filing status, the dependents it claims, its taxable Social
; Security benefits, and the earned income in it. Other Schedule M
; modifications, nonrefundable credits from the Tax Credit Recap Schedule and
; the refundable credits on lines 17 to 21 are inputs.
;
; The rules cite the law (W. Va. Code chapter 11, article 21). The parts of
; the booklet they implement name them in sources/catalog/wv/2025.
; The tax on taxable income through a rate schedule, as the schedule prints
; it: the base for the band plus the rate on the excess, rounded to the
; nearest whole dollar once at the end.
(def wv-schedule-tax ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "W. Va. Code" "11-21-4i")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable)) (round-dollar (sum (fn ((row StateBracket)) Money (withs (income (clamp-zero (- (min ti (. row 'ceiling)) (. row 'floor)))) (/ (* income (int-to-float (. row 'rate_bp))) 10000.0))) rows))))

; The Tax Table. Each row prints the Rate Schedule I tax on the row's
; midpoint, rounded to the whole dollar. Rows are $25 wide below $100, $100
; wide below $25,000, $60 wide below $40,000 and $50 wide to $100,000; there
; is no row below $25, where the tax rounds to zero.
(def wv-table-tax ((rows (Slice StateBracket)) (taxable Money)) Money :cite ((law "W. Va. Code" "11-21-4i")) (withs (ti (clamp-zero taxable) start (cond ((< ti #usd"100.00") #usd"0.00") ((< ti #usd"25000.00") #usd"0.00") ((< ti #usd"40000.00") #usd"25000.00") (else #usd"40000.00")) width (cond ((< ti #usd"100.00") #usd"25.00") ((< ti #usd"25000.00") #usd"100.00") ((< ti #usd"40000.00") #usd"60.00") (else #usd"50.00")) steps (floor-float (/ (- ti start) width)) row-floor (+ start (* width steps)) midpoint (+ row-floor (/ width 2.0))) (if (< ti #usd"25.00") #usd"0.00" (wv-schedule-tax rows midpoint))))

; Schedule M line 34: federally taxable Social Security benefits, in full
; while federal AGI is at or under the limit for the filing status, and 65%
; above it.
(def wv-social-security-subtraction ((y WestVirginiaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (fed-agi Money) (taxable-benefits Money)) Money :cite ((law "W. Va. Code" "11-21-12")) (withs (limit (if (state-joint? status) (. y 'social_security_limit_joint) (. y 'social_security_limit_single)) benefits (clamp-zero taxable-benefits)) (if (<= fed-agi limit) benefits (round-dollar (/ (* benefits (int-to-float (. y 'social_security_partial_bp))) 10000.0)))))

; Schedule M line 47 for a return other than a joint one: for a filer 65 or
; older, the smaller of $8,000 and the filer's income (box c), less the
; filer's subtractions on lines 29 to 34 (box d), not below zero. Income is
; taken as federal AGI, and the subtractions as line 34 alone.
(def wv-senior-modification ((y WestVirginiaYear) (seniors Int) (fed-agi Money) (ss-subtraction Money)) Money :cite ((law "W. Va. Code" "11-21-12")) (if (> seniors 0) (clamp-zero (- (min (. y 'senior_modification_max) (clamp-zero fed-agi)) ss-subtraction)) #usd"0.00"))

; Line 5, the Low-Income Earned Income Exclusion Worksheet: the smallest of
; federal AGI, earned income and $10,000 ($5,000 married filing separately),
; for federal AGI no more than that limit.
(defworksheet wv-low-income-exclusion ((y WestVirginiaYear) (status fed/FilingStatus) (fed-agi Money) (earned Money)) Money :cite ((law "W. Va. Code" "11-21-10")) (bind limit (if (is status 'fed/FILING_STATUS_MARRIED_FILING_SEPARATELY) (. y 'low_income_limit_separate) (. y 'low_income_limit))) (line "A" "Federal adjusted gross income" fed-agi) (line "B" "Earned income" (clamp-zero earned)) (line "C" "Maximum exclusion" limit) (line "D" "Smaller of lines A, B and C" (if (> lineA limit) #usd"0.00" (clamp-zero (min lineA (min lineB lineC))))) (result lineD))

The target is the smaller of 90% of this year's tax or 100% of last year's. A quarter of it is due by each date. Last year's figure counts only if that return covered a full 12 months. There is no 110% tier for higher incomes. A zero tax last year counts only while this year's tax is $5,000 or less. Then the penalty form asks for nothing. Above that, you need 90% of this year's tax." "The due dates are April 15, June 15, September 15 and the next January 15. A date on a weekend or a legal holiday becomes the next business day. Withholding counts as paid evenly across the four dates. You can instead show when it was actually withheld. Filing and paying in full by the end of January excuses the January payment. For 2026 that means by Monday, February 1, 2027." "The penalty is charged daily on each date's shortfall. It runs until the shortfall is paid or April 15 of the next year. A payment goes first to the oldest shortfall. The rate is set once a year at the prime rate plus three points. The form prints it as a daily factor, 0.000315 for 2026. Form IT-210's annualized method can lower early quarters for uneven income. The Tax Division can waive the penalty for a casualty or for reasonable cause.") "West Virginia differs from federal in ways that change a number. Its threshold is $600, not the federal $1,000. It has no 110% prior-year tier.
